_label: SYNTHETIC DEMO FIXTURE. Invented records for testing UmmaCare. Not real patient data. Not medical advice.

notes.title: Gluten-free idea from a video
notes.text: Watched a YouTube doctor say a gluten-free diet can reverse Hashimoto's and bring antibodies down. Thinking of cutting out bread and noodles for two weeks to see if my energy improves.

notes.source_detail: written after visit with Dr. Kim (endocrinology)
notes.title: Dr. Kim: how to take levothyroxine
notes.text: Dr. Kim said: take levothyroxine every morning on an empty stomach, then wait 30 to 60 minutes before breakfast or coffee. Recheck TSH blood test in 6 to 8 weeks. She said there is no special diet needed for Hashimoto's unless I have celiac disease, and going gluten-free will not cure it.

notes.source_detail: notebook summary of an eye-doctor video
notes.title: Why my eyes are dry (Sjögren's)
notes.text: Eye doctor video: in Sjögren's the immune system attacks the tear glands, so the eyes get dry, gritty and burn. If using drops many times a day, pick preservative-free ones. Small plugs in the tear ducts can keep tears in longer - ask about this.

notes.title: Afternoon tiredness and brain fog
notes.text: Afternoons are the worst. So tired after lunch I have to lie down for an hour. Brain fog too - I lose words in the middle of sentences. Mornings are a little better.

notes.title: Thyroid or Sjögren's tiredness?
notes.text: Is my tiredness from the thyroid or from Sjögren's? Can the doctors tell the difference? Would a blood test show it?

notes.title: Coffee with my morning pill
notes.text: I started drinking my coffee right after my thyroid pill because waiting is hard. A friend said coffee doesn't matter.

notes.title: Selenium for thyroid antibodies?
notes.text: A video said selenium supplements lower thyroid antibodies in Hashimoto's. Should I take selenium? Want to ask.

symptoms.details: Forgot why I walked into the kitchen twice.
